name: mc-router
author: 50152835+s3tupw1zard@users.noreply.github.com
description: Routes Minecraft Java Edition connections to backend servers based on the requested hostname. Uses a Pelican-compatible multi-architecture image with mc-router preinstalled.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/routes.json.example ]]; then
    cat > /mnt/server/routes.json.example <<'EOF'
{
  "default-server": "",
  "mappings": {
    "smp.example.com": "10.0.0.10:50000",
    "private.example.com": "10.0.0.11:50001"
  }
}
EOF
fi

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/routes.json ]]; then
    cp /mnt/server/routes.json.example /mnt/server/routes.json
fi

echo "mc-router installation complete."
echo "Edit routes.json to configure hostname routing."
